description: Schema for stallari-bundle.yaml — a minimal bundle artifact that names a set of co-installed members and a shared version pin (DD-404). A bundle is the install unit for artifacts that must travel together — e.g. a pack that requires its add-on and vice-versa. The bundle keeps the dependency graph ACYCLIC: members do not declare edges to one another; the bundle is the single install/remove/version unit. A bundle is NOT a fourth lifecycle — it carries no behaviour of its own beyond membership.

bundle.description: Bundle manifest spec version (e.g. '1.0'). Discriminates this artifact as a bundle.

description.description: Human-readable summary of what the bundle installs as one unit.

members.description: The artifacts installed together as one unit. A bundle of fewer than two members is pointless — install the single artifact directly. Members span artifact classes (e.g. a pack + an add-on). No member declares a dependency on another member; the bundle is the coupling.

kind.description: Artifact class of this member (DD-404 taxonomy: pack, plugin/MCP, or add-on).

version.description: Member semantic version pinned by this bundle.
Bundle semantic version. Installing the bundle installs its members atomically; the bundle version pins the member set.

title: Stallari Bundle Manifest
